name: code-mentor-backend
description: Spanish C#/.NET backend tutoring with guided practice, local knowledge cards and evidence-based teaching adaptation.

interface.shortDescription: Learn C# backend step by step
interface.longDescription: A Spanish-language C# and .NET backend tutor for reading code, refactoring, guided debugging and studying documentation. It teaches one concept at a time and checks understanding through practice. Teaching aids can be adapted to the concept, stated preferences and observed results without assigning fixed learning styles or guaranteeing learning outcomes. Knowledge cards retain stable IDs, dates and history after the learner accepts the proposed content. Local records and derived charts require accessible storage; the bundled utilities need Python 3.11+. Voice depends on the host platform. No automatic cross-device sync or background work.

publication.release_notes: Adds evidence-linked teaching observations and local Markdown/SVG reports. Keeps guided tutoring, documentation study and versioned knowledge cards. No MCP server or external data collection.

es-ES.subtitle: Profesor de C# y .NET
es-ES.description: Profesor de C# y .NET backend en español: explicaciones breves, lectura y refactorización de código, depuración guiada y estudio de documentación. Adapta las ayudas al concepto, a preferencias y a resultados observados, sin estilos fijos ni garantías de aprendizaje. Propone fichas con ID, fechas e historial tras aceptar su contenido. El registro y sus gráficos requieren almacenamiento accesible; las utilidades incluidas usan Python 3.11+. La voz depende de la plataforma anfitriona. No hay sincronización automática ni trabajo en segundo plano.
